saw_lines: Prop firm buyers compare funding, rules and payout speed before they pick one, then stick with the firm that pays.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where a trader decides if the firm looks real.
Your site shows 100,000+ Happy Traders, yet 0 of 30 ads carry it. Put that number on the creative and in line one of every ad.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 15 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 100,000+ Happy Traders, yet 0 of 30 ads carry it. New traders have no reason to believe an unproven claim. Put 100,000+ on the creative and in line one, then open two ads with a review quote.

17 of your 30 ads open on the same 40% off line, so every buyer hears one pitch. Test two or three new openers from your product, such as daily payouts or the evaluation path, and run each against the 17.

Your site shows prices up to $359, yet 0 of 30 ads mention price. A trader comparing firms wants the cost before clicking. Lead one ad with the price of one account beside the $750K funding it unlocks.
One exact copy runs in 17 of your 30 ads, so the same words keep reaching the same buyers. Keep the body copy, rewrite the opening line, and swap the creative in each ad, so no two look identical.

ads_1: Creative led by daily payouts and the evaluation path, tested against the current opener
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X and YouTube
